summary: Full backend + frontend regression for SWARM-X Guardian rebuild. All 14 pytest backend endpoints pass and every UI flow requested by main agent works with 0 console errors.
action_items: Docs-only: The review request lists arch layer ids as 'arch-layer-mission..arch-layer-environment' with 'allocation/transport/execution', but the actual implementation uses ids: mission, coordination, agent, mesh, safety, environment. All 6 render and expand correctly. Consider aligning docs / review checklist.
critical_code_review_comments: Global in-memory `world` in server.py means all clients share a single simulation instance. Fine for a demo but must be scoped per-user for multi-tenant usage.
/api/metrics uses a private method (`world._metrics()`); expose a public accessor for cleanliness.
asyncio startup task has no cancellation on shutdown — acceptable for demo but leaks if reloaded.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests reset simulation to known scenarios (normal, agent_failure) — no persistent DB rows written.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest). Frontend nav testids nav-overview..nav-settings all mounted. Architecture layer testids: mission, coordination, agent, mesh, safety, environment (NOT allocation/transport/execution as stated in review request). Missions form: missions-new-task-button opens overlay with data-testid=missions-new-task-form, submit via task-submit-button. Simulation network buttons are network-<state-lowercased>. Experiments CSV export triggers download with filename swarm-x-experiments.csv. Mobile nav toggle testid: mobile-nav-toggle.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. Two flakes in the first Playwright run were due to my tests using wrong selectors (text-match 'New' before form opened, and non-existent arch layer ids). Corrected in second run and all pass.
